notes: v1.9 FIX: Dashboard table empty (and the real cause of the opens-then-closes bug). v1.6 hid Box ID by using the box id as the tree item id but wrote insert(..., end="end") as a keyword, which tkinter rejects — the first row threw TypeError, so the table stayed empty while counts/Excel updated, and before v1.8 that error closed the app on startup. Fixed to insert("", "end", iid=box_id, ...). Table now shows all of today's boxes with Return / Sell Amount / Bill No. Includes v1.8 (crash-proof startup, safe mode), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
